caption: Performance of different triggers. The words used as triggers on the horizontal axis are arranged in ascending order according to the ASR of the clean model.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the performance of different triggers, with ASR values represented on the vertical axis and trigger words on the horizontal axis. The x-axis is labeled with trigger words, including cf, bb, WNBA, ESPN, NHL, FIFA, Estadio, and athletics, which are listed in order of ascending ASR values for a clean model. The y-axis is labeled "ASR" and has a scale type that appears to be linear, with a value range of 0.5 to 0.9 and tick labels at intervals of 0.1. There are three lines in the plot, each representing a different category: start, random, and end. The start line is green, has no markers, and starts at approximately 0.77 for cf, peaks at around 0.94 for WNBA, and ends at around 0.87 for athletics. The random line is orange, marked with x-shaped markers, starts at approximately 0.49 for cf, peaks at around 0.94 for WNBA, and ends at around 0.79 for athletics. The end line is purple, marked with circular markers, starts at approximately 0.59 for cf, peaks at around 0.95 for WNBA, and ends at around 0.84 for athletics.
